title: CCA Schema 0.1
description: A slim interchange schema for a single automatic or manual content-analysis classification task.

$schema.description: URI identifying the JSON Schema against which this codebook document is validated.

version.description: Semantic version of this particular codebook.

title.description: Human-readable name of the classification task.

description.description: Short description of the construct measured by the classification task.

language.description: BCP 47 language tag for the codebook's instructions, definitions, and examples. A codebook document has only one language.

created_at.description: Date on which this codebook version was created, in ISO 8601 full-date format.

modified_at.description: Date on which this codebook version was last modified, in ISO 8601 full-date format.

references.description: Theoretical or methodological sources for the codebook.

examples.description: Coding examples whose labels refer to category IDs defined in task.categories.

personNames.description: Names of people or organizations responsible for the codebook.

instructions.description: General coding instructions for the task. Markdown may be used.

unit_of_analysis.description: Description of the unit that receives one classification, such as sentence, paragraph, post, or document.

classification_mode.description: Whether exactly one or multiple category labels may be assigned to a unit.

context.description: Description of additional context that may be used and how it should affect coding.

categories.description: Permitted classification categories. Category IDs must be unique within the document.
categories.$comment: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 cannot enforce uniqueness of one property across array objects; implementations must verify unique category IDs.

id.description: Stable machine-facing category identifier. Conventional manual codes such as '102' are permitted.

definition.description: Conceptual and operational meaning of the category.

inclusion_criteria.description: Conditions supporting assignment of this category.

exclusion_criteria.description: Similar cases in which this category must not be assigned.

coding_notes.description: Additional remarks or clarifications for coding.

aliases.description: Alternative or historical labels for this category.

labels.description: Correct category ID or IDs for the example. Each value must match an ID in task.categories.
labels.$comment: Referential integrity between example labels and task category IDs must be verified by implementations.

context.description: Additional contextual material for interpreting the example.

explanation.description: Explanation of why the assigned labels apply.
